# Leveling a Hunter — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots level with).** The party fixtures put this class on beast-mastery (6 members). The main line is **beast-mastery** — Endgame build (level 60), 34/17/0, with a respec at level 60. Every order below is what the module grants level by level (the earlier builds first, then the level-60 build). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/hunter/*/talents.yaml`]

**This page is the bots' half.** It records which spec the bots level with, the talent order they execute level by level, the abilities their kit teaches and the consumables they carry. The hand-written guide for this class is [leveling.md](./leveling.md).

## Gameplay by level

The combat rules that come online in each bracket, in the loop's own order (ascending priority). `level_min` is the rule's own gate; the decision loop skips a rule until then. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here and their items are in the band tables below.

### Beast Mastery

#### Levels 10–19

- **7 — Call Pet** (`HB00b-call-pet`, level 10+) — When: the pet does not exist; not in combat; the resident is not eating or drinking; time since the resident cast Call Pet is at least 60 s.
- **8 — Revive Pet** (`HB00c-revive-pet`, level 10+) — When: the pet exists; the pet is not alive; not in combat; the resident is not moving; mana at least 70%; the resident is not eating or drinking.
- **9 — pet attack** (`HB00d-pet-attack`, level 10+) — When: in combat; the pet exists; the pet is alive; the pet is not on the target; the target is hostile; (the tank has opened threat on the target or the target is attacking the resident or the lowest party health below 0%).
- **13 — Wing Clip** (`HB07f-wing-clip-runner`, level 12+) — When: in combat; the target is hostile; the target is fleeing; in melee range; Wing Clip is off cooldown; at least 40 mana.
- **20 — Aspect of the Hawk** (`HB02-aspect-of-the-hawk`, level 10+) — When: not (the resident has Aspect of the Cheetah and not in combat and the target is not hostile); the resident does not have Aspect of the Hawk; not (in combat and the resident has Aspect of the Viper); mana at least 20%; at least 20 mana; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking).
- **55 — Scare Beast** (`HB05s-scare-beast-second`, level 14+) — When: in combat; the lowest party health below 0%; the target is attacking the resident; the target is Beast; the target does not have Scare Beast; the target does not have Scare Beast; at least 2 engaged enemies within 30 yd; the target is within 30 yd; the resident is not moving; at least 50 mana; Scare Beast is off cooldown.
- **70 — Wing Clip** (`HB07-wing-clip`, level 12+) — When: the target is hostile; in melee range; Wing Clip is off cooldown; at least 40 mana.
- **85 — Mend Pet** (`HB08b-mend-pet`, level 12+) — When: in combat; the pet exists; the pet is alive; pet health below 50%; the resident is not moving; at least 50 mana.
- **90 — Multi-Shot** (`HB09-multi-shot`, level 18+) — When: the target is hostile; character level at least 30; (at least 3 engaged enemies within 15 yd or character level at least 60 and at least 2 engaged enemies within 15 yd); the target is at least 8 yd away; the target is within 15 yd; Multi-Shot is off cooldown; mana at least 27%; at least 100 mana; not a polymorphed or otherwise CC'd unit within 30 yd.
- **111 — Mongoose Bite** (`HB11b-mongoose-bite`, level 16+) — When: the target is hostile; in melee range; Mongoose Bite is off cooldown; at least 30 mana.

#### Levels 20–29

- **14 — Scorpid Sting** (`HB01s2-scorpid-sting-elite`, level 22+) — When: in combat; the target is hostile; the target is elite; the target is not a dungeon boss; the pet exists; the pet is alive; pet health below 70%; the target does not have Scorpid Sting; the target does not have Serpent Sting; the target is at least 8 yd away; the target is within 35 yd; at least 70 mana.
- **21 — Aspect of the Cheetah** (`HB02c-aspect-of-the-cheetah`, level 20+) — When: not in combat; the target is not hostile; the resident does not have Aspect of the Cheetah; mana at least 70%; at least 40 mana; the resident is not eating or drinking.
- **31 — Rapid Fire** (`HB03r-rapid-fire`, level 26+) — When: in combat; the target is hostile; the target is elite; the target is at least 8 yd away; the target is within 35 yd; Rapid Fire is off cooldown; at least 100 mana; (the tank has opened threat on the target or the lowest party health below 0%).
- **95 — Steady Shot** (`HB09a-steady-shot`, level 20+) — When: the target is hostile; the target is at least 8 yd away; the target is within 35 yd; the resident is not moving.

#### Levels 30–39

- **30 — Bestial Wrath** (`HB03-bestial-wrath`, level 39+) — When: in combat; the pet exists; the pet is alive; the resident does not have Bestial Wrath; Bestial Wrath is off cooldown.
- **41 — Feign Death** (`HB04f-feign-death`, level 30+) — When: in combat; the target is hostile; the target is attacking the resident; the pet exists; the pet is alive; Feign Death is off cooldown; at least 80 mana; no engaged creature of entry 60738.

#### Levels 40–49

- **-110 — Use Elixir of the Mongoose** (`HB00u-mongoose`, level 46+) — When: not in combat; the resident is not moving; the resident is not eating or drinking; carries Elixir of the Mongoose; Elixir of the Mongoose is off cooldown; the resident does not have Elixir of the Mongoose.
- **-107 — Use Mageblood Potion** (`HB00u-mageblood`, level 40+) — When: not in combat; the resident is not moving; the resident is not eating or drinking; carries Mageblood Potion; Mageblood Potion is off cooldown; the resident does not have Mana Regeneration.
- **-106 — Use Greater Arcane Elixir** (`HB00u-greater-arcane-elixir`, level 47+) — When: not in combat; the resident is not moving; the resident is not eating or drinking; carries Greater Arcane Elixir; Greater Arcane Elixir is off cooldown; the resident does not have Greater Arcane Elixir.
- **-105 — Use Elixir of Greater Nature Power** (`HB00u-nature-power`, level 48+) — When: not in combat; the resident is not moving; the resident is not eating or drinking; carries Elixir of Greater Nature Power; Elixir of Greater Nature Power is off cooldown; the resident does not have Elixir of Greater Nature Power.
- **-104 — Use Dreamshard Elixir** (`HB00u-dreamshard`, level 46+) — When: not in combat; the resident is not moving; the resident is not eating or drinking; carries Dreamshard Elixir; Dreamshard Elixir is off cooldown; the resident does not have Dreamshard Elixir.
- **-102 — Apply Brilliant Mana Oil** (`HB00u-mana-oil-main`, level 45+) — When: (the main hand is a one-handed axe or the main hand is a two-handed axe or the main hand is a one-handed mace or the main hand is a two-handed mace or the main hand is a polearm or the main hand is a one-handed sword or the main hand is a two-handed sword or the main hand is a staff or the main hand is a fist weapon or the main hand is a dagger or the main hand is a weapon); not in combat; the resident is not moving; carries Brilliant Mana Oil; (the main hand does not have Brilliant Mana Oil or main-hand imbue time left is less than 300 s); the resident is not eating or drinking.
- **-101 — Apply Brilliant Mana Oil** (`HB00u-mana-oil-off`, level 45+) — When: (the off hand is a one-handed axe or the off hand is a two-handed axe or the off hand is a one-handed mace or the off hand is a two-handed mace or the off hand is a polearm or the off hand is a one-handed sword or the off hand is a two-handed sword or the off hand is a staff or the off hand is a fist weapon or the off hand is a dagger or the off hand is a weapon); not in combat; the resident is not moving; carries Brilliant Mana Oil; (the off hand does not have Brilliant Mana Oil or off-hand imbue time left is less than 300 s); the resident is not eating or drinking.
- **23 — Trueshot Aura** (`HB02b-trueshot-aura`, level 40+) — When: not in combat; the resident does not have Trueshot Aura; the resident is not eating or drinking.
- **28 — Kill Command** (`HB05-kill-command`, level 43+) — When: in combat; the resident has the aura state 6 state; Kill Command is off cooldown; the pet exists; the pet is alive.

## Situational rules

Sentences copied from the rules' own notes, where the poison/creature-type, seal, stance, form and consumable advice lives.

### Beast Mastery

- **HB04f-feign-death:** HO-TKB-PLAY-147 (p4-pioneer decision 194, track 4 steps up to Gnomeregan at 34): "If the mob turns on you while the pet is alive: Feign Death, and the mob goes back to the pet", "If a mob sticks to you: Concussive Shot and kite, or Feign Death" (hunter/leveling.md L181, L187; "Before 30 you have no Feign Death", L149). HO-TKB-PLAY-174 (PIONEER FIX, observer Hateforge playbook section 1.5, p4-group 456 core-script read L296-L339, vocabulary v35 enemies_engaged_entry): never while Har'gesh Doomcaller (60737) has a Faceless Terror (60738) alive: a Terror with no victim calls the boss EnterEvadeMode every 5 s, which resets him to full health and despawns the Terrors, and an evade by a hunter or rogue leaves the Terror victimless.
- **HB06f-concussive-shot-runner:** HO-TKB-PLAY-143 (p4-group, round 130: the top party wipe cause, 12 wipe-fights in the Deadmines, was foundry goblins fleeing at 15 per cent to fetch help within 30 yd; p3-runtime 357 makes the melee follow a fleer at or under 25 per cent; bears, paladins, rogues and shamans already stop runners on target.fleeing): Concussive Shot (50 per cent slow, 4 s) on a runner in shot range.
- **HB07f-wing-clip-runner:** HO-TKB-PLAY-143 (p4-group, round 130: the top party wipe cause, 12 wipe-fights in the Deadmines, was foundry goblins fleeing at 15 per cent to fetch help within 30 yd; p3-runtime 357 makes the melee follow a fleer at or under 25 per cent; bears, paladins, rogues and shamans already stop runners on target.fleeing): Wing Clip on a runner still in melee reach.
- **HB01s-serpent-sting-boss:** HO-TKB-PLAY-132 (p4-pioneer decision 189 (d); p1-loop v27 target.boss): "Skip on normal mobs ... Use Serpent Sting only as a boss opener in dungeons" (hunter/leveling.md L127, L165, L286): once the tank holds the boss, once per boss (aura_target, the first rank of the chain).
- **HB03r-rapid-fire:** In a party only once the tank has opened threat on the target, as the pet''s attack waits.
- **HB00b-call-pet:** Quest reward at 10 (quest 6082 'Taming the Beast', kit.yaml), costs nothing (spell_template manaCost 0) and needs no target: effectImplicitTargetA1 32, targets 0, so the loop's own targetGuid (healTarget or hostile) is irrelevant, the same way a self-only buff resolves regardless of what RotationAction passes (Loop.cpp's own comment, next to Fade and Inner Fire). Priority 7, straight after HB00a-eat (6) and before every buff (HB01a at 15) and before the opener (HB01 at 10): THE PET WAS NEVER MISSING FROM THE DATABASE, ONLY FROM THE WORLD -- this spec is the one that names the pet its whole point, and it had no rule to bring one into being.
- **HB00c-revive-pet:** Quest reward at 10 (quest 6081 'Training the Beast', kit.yaml, same acquisition tier as Call Pet), a 10 s cast (castingTimeIndex 7, SpellCastTimes.dbc CastTime 10000) and NOT free: manaCost 0 but manaCostPercentage 100, which Spell::CalculatePowerCost prices at 100 per cent of BASE mana for the caster's level (player_classlevelstats: hunter level 23 is 541) -- the whole bar, not a share of it. `mana_pct >= 100` was the first draft and was DISCARDED: it is only ever true at a single mana level, which is the same failure class this workstream's reactive rules already document elsewhere (a guard that is merely safe but rarely true just re-fires the refusal every tick), and decision 42 asks for a pet that WORKS, not one that is technically affordable and never revived.
- **HB00d-pet-attack:** HO-TKB-PLAY-048 (orchestrator, p4-group 123; HO-P4-GROUP-123 read round 79): send the pet at the resident's target once the fight is on, and again on a target change (pet.attacking is true only when the pet's victim is MY target). A defensive player pet ignores its owner's attack while it is out of combat (PetAI::OwnerAttacked returns when the pet is not in combat and its owner is a player), so with no rule that sends it in it fought only what hit it or its owner: on the tank's target on 84 of 169 in-combat ticks in round 79.
- **HB01s2-scorpid-sting-elite:** amp-6 rotation patch (owner order 2026-10-18, beyond HO-TKB-PLAY-212): the guide's Scorpid Sting rule is "Scorpid Sting only to help the pet tank an elite. It shares the one-Sting-per-hunter limit with Serpent Sting, so it yields to a Serpent already on the target (`not aura_target(1978)`) and it is NOT used on a boss, which keeps the Serpent opener of HB01s-serpent-sting-boss; it is for the elite the pet (or a levelling hunter) is tanking.
- **HB01a-aspect-of-the-viper:** At the pin it is a level-56 trainer aspect costing nothing to cast whose single effect is aura 21 (SPELL_AURA_OBS_MOD_MANA), a periodic mana return, and it replaces Aspect of the Hawk because a hunter holds one aspect at a time. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **HB02-aspect-of-the-hawk:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **HB02a-aspect-of-the-monkey:** Aspect of the Hawk (level 10, priority above this rule) replaces it: `not aura_self(13165)` keeps the two from flapping and the Hawk rule wins the tick whenever it can be cast.
- **HB02b-trueshot-aura:** HO-TKB-PLAY-280 (leveller pass): Trueshot Aura is trained at 40 as a baseline single-rank aura (hunter/leveling.md L198, L287); the marksmanship file already holds it, the beast-mastery file never cast it, so a BM hunter of 40-60 gave its party no ranged attack power. Free (manaCost 0), permanent, and an area party aura that also sits on the hunter (see HM02-trueshot-aura), so aura_self sees it; one cast a session.
- **HB03-bestial-wrath:** Beast Mastery talent (386); free, 90 s recoveryTime, 18 s. `target.hostile` is dropped (in_combat carries the intent) and the pet terms the spell needs (its target is the caster's pet, effectImplicitTargetA1 5) are added.
- **HB04-intimidation:** Beast Mastery talent (387); free, 60 s recoveryTime, and it stuns what the pet is on. Gated on target.attacking_self, because the moment worth a minute of cooldown is the one where the mob has left the pet and come for the hunter.
- **HB05-kill-command:** Beast Mastery talent (391) at 40, DependsOn Spirit Bond 2/2; free, 8 s recoveryTime, 45 yd, and casterAuraState 6, which is AURA_STATE_CRIT -- the state the core sets on a caster that has recently critically hit. So this is a reactive: it is the only rule in any hunter file the vocabulary can gate exactly, and it is the only rule in this file that is about the pet at all, since what it does is order the pet to strike.
- **HB05s-scare-beast-second:** The guide, hunter/leveling.md L148: "On beasts, Scare Beast the second mob (1.5 s cast)"; the pet and the shots take the first. Alone only (in a party a feared mob runs into the group), the second attacker is a beast (`creature_type(1)`), 35 mana at level 14, 50 at rank 2 (level 30).
- **HB06-concussive-shot:** HO-TKB-PLAY-280 (leveller pass): with a living pet the slow is for the mob that has turned on the hunter, not for a mob the pet is holding: "If the mob turns on you: Concussive Shot, then back off and let Growl take it back" (hunter/leveling.md L143), "If a mob sticks to you: Concussive Shot and kite" (L187), "Losing aggro, or the pet dies: Feign Death, or Concussive Shot and kite" (L300). Below 10 there is no pet and the guide opens with it as the pull (L125), and without a living pet it is the old rule; the runner rule HB06f is unchanged.
- **HB08b-mend-pet:** Trainer spell at 12 (kit.yaml, trainer_learn_spell 1117), 50 mana at the pin (spell_template manaCost 50) and, contrary to how it reads, NOT instant: attributesEx 4 is SPELL_ATTR_EX_CHANNELED_1 and durationIndex 28 is 5000 ms -- 'heals your pet X health every second while you focus, lasts 5s' -- the same shape as the warlock's Health Funnel (755), which decision 44 keeps strictly out of combat. CHECKED BEFORE SHIPPING IT IN COMBAT: channelInterruptFlags is 31756 (0x7C0C) at the pin, which decodes to CHANNEL_FLAG_INTERRUPT (0x0004), CHANNEL_FLAG_MOVEMENT (0x0008) and CHANNEL_FLAG_DELAY (0x4000) -- CHANNEL_FLAG_DAMAGE (0x0002) and CHANNEL_FLAG_DAMAGE2 (0x0080) are both ABSENT, so taking a hit does not break this channel, which closes the specific re-fire risk (a half-broken channel next to an active fight) that would otherwise be the strongest argument against it.

### Marksmanship

- **HM00b-call-pet:** Quest reward at 10 (quest 6082 'Taming the Beast', kit.yaml), costs nothing (spell_template manaCost 0) and needs no target: effectImplicitTargetA1 32, targets 0, so the loop's own targetGuid (healTarget or hostile) is irrelevant, the same way a self-only buff resolves regardless of what RotationAction passes (Loop.cpp's own comment, next to Fade and Inner Fire). Priority 7, straight after HM00a-eat (6) and before every buff (HM02 at 20): THE PET WAS NEVER MISSING FROM THE DATABASE, ONLY FROM THE WORLD.
